page.layout: One page of text, single column; no margin notes. Page number at top right. Running title centred above the heading block. Heading lines: "JVSTI LIPSII" and "NOTÆ AD LIB. I." then "CAPUT II." Body in one column.

main_text.head: JVSTI LIPSII NOTÆ AD LIB. I.
CAPVT II.
main_text.p: PAg. 4. lin. 9. GABALVM] Exoticam vocem esse per me suspicabar, didici & Hebræam origine à Mart. Antonio Delrio, doctissimo & amicissimo viro. nam illis Gab, excelsum: Gabal, terminus, aut rectus stipes in agris. Quid nisi tale crux, quæ erecta, & in excelso? Reperio & in Persicarum vocum indice (à Franc. Raphelengio nostro habui) Gali notare excelsum. Jam nostras vox quantulum abit, qui patibulum Galgam appellamus? Sed nec Gallica valde abludit.
Pag. 6. lin. 8. & 9. Cruces Caucasorum.] Potes pro ipsis suppliciis accipere, & cruciaria morte.

page.notes: Marginal text: none printed beside the body. The heading "JVSTI LIPSII NOTÆ AD LIB. I." is treated as a title head. The first line "PAg. 4." is the printed "Pag. 4." with a drop capital P. The final word "te." sits alone at the right of the last line. Several Hebrew and Persian words are printed in Latin letters as shown.
